title.narrative: Tuberculosis Implementation Framework Agreement (TIFA)

description.narrative: TIFA will improve government capacity and commitment, leverage domestic resources to maximize impact and sustain results as we work together to achieve the global target of treating 40 million people with TB by 2022. As USAID looks forward to the day when foreign assistance for TB is no longer necessary, TIFA will emphasize host government ownership and accountability of the TB programs in priority countries. TIFA recipients will create agreements with local government entities to build organizational and technical capacity to improve TB services and to sustain results long after the life of the project. Through TIFA, host governments will be empowered to implement locally-generated, context-specific solutions; focus on the scale- up of new technologies with proven results to improve TB case-detection and treatment outcomes, and utilize new approaches to increase local ownership. Newly created partnerships with local government entities will identify quantifiable milestones and targets in order to strengthen accountability of local governments and increase ownership of their TB program. TIFA s primary objectives include: ? Developing efficient mechanisms for support to national TB programs and local government entities to effectively implement National TB Strategic Plans; ? Empowering local government entities to become more self-reliant; and ? Leveraging and advocating for additional domestic resources for TB at all levels among local government entities.

title.narrative: New Partnerships Initiative: EXPAND (New Partners for Better Health)
Initiative de nouveaux partenariats : EXPAND (Nouveaux partenaires pour une meilleure santé)
Initiative de nouveaux partenariats : EXPAND (Nouveaux partenaires pour une meilleure santé)
Iniciativa de Nuevas Alianzas: EXPAND (Nuevos Socios para una Mejor Salud)
Iniciativa de Novas Parcerias: EXPAND (Novos Parceiros para uma Saúde Melhor)

description.narrative: New Partnerships Initiative (NPI) EXPAND (New Partners for Better Health) is a five-year (2019-2024), $43.9 million global project with the goal of working with missions and organizations to increase the availability and utilization of quality health services across all USAID priority health areas. NPI EXPAND will catalyze opportunities to scale up innovative interventions by strengthening the capacity of New and Underutilized Partners (NUP) with varying levels of capabilities and exposure to USAID. In line with the Journey to Self-Reliance, NPI EXPAND will support countries to identify and strengthen local organizations to participate fully in their local health system. New Partnerships Initiative will increase USAID s development impact by elevating local leadership, fostering creativity and innovation, and mobilizing resources across the Agency s programs. 1. Strengthen the organizational sustainability of new and underutilized local entities or locally established partners: Targeted countries will advance their self-reliance through a strengthened cadre of NUPs that are ready to meet the needs of the underserved. The activity will support NUPs to increase their managerial, financial, and administrative capacities to enhance their ability to not only receive direct support from USAID but also be more engaged partners within local health systems. 2. Expand utilization of high-quality, high-impact health services, information and supplies expanded: Participating NUPs will contribute to enhancing the supply and utilization of high-quality, integrated health services, with a focus on reaching underserved populations. NPI EXPAND supports this evolution by fostering the technical skills of providers, the expansion of services offered, quality assurance systems, and introducing cost-effective demand creation techniques that can be integrated in the service delivery setting. 3. New Partnerships Initiative (NPI) EXPAND (New Partners for Better Health) est un projet mondial quinquennal (2019-2024) d'un coût de 43,9 millions de dollars dont l'objectif est de travailler avec des missions et des organisations pour accroître la disponibilité et l'utilisation de services de santé de qualité dans tous les domaines de santé prioritaires de l'USAID. NPI EXPAND catalysera les opportunités d'intensifier les interventions innovantes en renforçant les capacités des partenaires nouveaux et sous-utilisés (NUP) avec différents niveaux de capacités et d'exposition à l'USAID. Conformément au parcours vers l'autonomie, NPI EXPAND aidera les pays à identifier et à renforcer les organisations locales pour participer pleinement à leur système de santé local. L'initiative de nouveaux partenariats augmentera l'impact de l'USAID sur le développement en élevant le leadership local, en favorisant la créativité et l'innovation et en mobilisant des ressources dans l'ensemble des programmes de l'Agence. 1. Renforcer la durabilité organisationnelle des entités locales nouvelles et sous-utilisées ou des partenaires établis localement : les pays ciblés feront progresser leur autonomie grâce à un cadre renforcé de NUP prêts à répondre aux besoins des personnes mal desservies. L'activité aidera les NUP à accroître leurs capacités de gestion, financières et administratives afin d'améliorer leur capacité non seulement à recevoir un soutien direct de l'USAID, mais également à devenir des partenaires plus engagés au sein des systèmes de santé locaux. 2. Élargir l'utilisation de services, d'informations et de fournitures de santé de haute qualité et à fort impact : les NUP participants contribueront à améliorer l'offre et l'utilisation de services de santé intégrés de haute qualité, en mettant l'accent sur l'atteinte des populations mal desservies. NPI EXPAND soutient cette évolution en favorisant les compétences techniques des prestataires, l'expansion des services offerts, les systèmes d'assurance qualité et l'introduction de techniques de création de demande rentables qui peuvent être intégrées dans le cadre de la prestation de services. 3. La Iniciativa de Nuevas Alianzas (NPI) EXPAND (Nuevos Socios para una Mejor Salud) es un proyecto global de cinco años (2019-2024) y de $43,9 millones de dólares cuyo objetivo es trabajar con misiones y organizaciones para aumentar la disponibilidad y utilización de servicios de salud de calidad en todas las áreas de salud prioritarias de USAID. NPI EXPAND catalizará oportunidades para ampliar intervenciones innovadoras fortaleciendo la capacidad de socios nuevos e infrautilizados (NUP) con diferentes niveles de capacidades y exposición a USAID. En línea con el Camino hacia la Autosuficiencia, NPI EXPAND ayudará a los países a identificar y fortalecer organizaciones locales para participar plenamente en su sistema de salud local. La Iniciativa de Nuevas Asociaciones aumentará el impacto de USAID en el desarrollo al elevar el liderazgo local, fomentar la creatividad y la innovación y movilizar recursos en todos los programas de la Agencia. 1. Fortalecer la sostenibilidad organizacional de entidades locales nuevas e infrautilizadas o socios establecidos localmente: los países seleccionados mejorarán su autosuficiencia a través de un cuadro fortalecido de PUN que estén listos para satisfacer las necesidades de los desatendidos. La actividad apoyará a las NUP a aumentar sus capacidades gerenciales, financieras y administrativas para mejorar su capacidad no solo de recibir apoyo directo de USAID sino también de ser socios más comprometidos dentro de los sistemas de salud locales. 2. Ampliar la utilización de servicios, información y suministros de salud de alta calidad y alto impacto: Las PUN participantes contribuirán a mejorar el suministro y la utilización de servicios de salud integrados y de alta calidad, centrándose en llegar a las poblaciones desatendidas. NPI EXPAND apoya esta evolución fomentando las habilidades técnicas de los proveedores, la expansión de los servicios ofrecidos, los sistemas de garantía de calidad y la introducción de técnicas rentables de creación de demanda que pueden integrarse en el entorno de prestación de servicios. 3. Aumentar la sostenibilidad de enfoques sanitarios prometedores e innovadores ampliados mediante nuevas estrategias.

Iniciativa de Novas Parcerias (NPI) EXPAND (Novos Parceiros para uma Saúde Melhor) é um projeto global de cinco anos (2019-2024), no valor de 43,9 milhões de dólares, com o objetivo de trabalhar com missões e organizações para aumentar a disponibilidade e utilização de serviços de saúde de qualidade em todas as áreas de saúde prioritárias da USAID. O NPI EXPAND irá catalisar oportunidades para ampliar intervenções inovadoras, fortalecendo a capacidade de Parceiros Novos e Subutilizados (NUP) com vários níveis de capacidades e exposição à USAID. Em linha com a Jornada para a Autossuficiência, o NPI EXPAND apoiará os países a identificar e fortalecer as organizações locais para participarem plenamente no seu sistema de saúde local. A Iniciativa de Novas Parcerias aumentará o impacto da USAID no desenvolvimento, elevando a liderança local, promovendo a criatividade e a inovação e mobilizando recursos em todos os programas da Agência. 1. Reforçar a sustentabilidade organizacional de entidades locais novas e subutilizadas ou de parceiros estabelecidos localmente: Os países visados ​​aumentarão a sua autossuficiência através de um quadro reforçado de NUPs que estão prontos para satisfazer as necessidades dos mais carenciados. A actividade apoiará os NUPs a aumentarem as suas capacidades de gestão, financeiras e administrativas para melhorar a sua capacidade não só de receberem apoio directo da USAID, mas também de serem parceiros mais empenhados nos sistemas de saúde locais. 2. Expandir a utilização de serviços de saúde de alta qualidade e de alto impacto, informação e fornecimentos alargados: Os NUPs participantes contribuirão para melhorar a oferta e a utilização de serviços de saúde integrados e de alta qualidade, com foco em alcançar as populações carenciadas. O NPI EXPAND apoia esta evolução promovendo as competências técnicas dos fornecedores, a expansão dos serviços oferecidos, sistemas de garantia de qualidade e introduzindo técnicas de criação de procura económicas que podem ser integradas no ambiente de prestação de serviços. 3. Aumentar a sustentabilidade de abordagens de saúde promissoras e inovadoras, ampliadas através de novas soluções.

Objectives for Worldwide: The NPI will increase USAID’s programmatic impact, based on more collaborative and adaptive partnering, and country progress outcomes, by doing the following: Leveraging private development assistance to respond to the Administration’s priorities and strengthen long-term partners for the Journey to Self-Reliance; Equipping and empowering new and underutilized development partners to maximize the impact of American tax dollars; Supporting solutions to near- and long-term Administration priorities that will advance the President’s National Security Strategy and support the Foreign Assistance Realignment; Identifying development solutions that will be country- and partner-driven for maximum long-term impact; and Creating incentives for expanding and diversifying USAID’s partner base so that we help to equip and fund more partners to support country-level progress.

title.narrative: One Health Workforce - Next Generation (OHW-NG)
One Health Workforce - Nouvelle génération (OHW-NG)
One Health Workforce - Nouvelle génération (OHW-NG)

description.narrative: The USAID One Health Workforce - Next Generation (OHW-NG) project promotes global health security by empowering One Health University Networks in Africa and Southeast Asia to build the human resources and bolster the workforce for more effective disease surveillance and control. Using a variety of pre-service and in-service formats, including One Health student clubs and experiential learning, OHW-NG is fostering One Health competencies.

Le projet USAID One Health Workforce - Next Generation (OHW-NG) promeut la sécurité sanitaire mondiale en donnant aux réseaux universitaires One Health en Afrique et en Asie du Sud-Est les moyens de renforcer les ressources humaines et de renforcer la main-d'œuvre pour une surveillance et un contrôle plus efficaces des maladies. En utilisant une variété de formats de formation préalable et continue, y compris les clubs étudiants One Health et l'apprentissage expérientiel, OHW-NG favorise les compétences One Health.

Le projet USAID One Health Workforce - Next Generation (OHW-NG) promeut la sécurité sanitaire mondiale en donnant aux réseaux universitaires One Health en Afrique et en Asie du Sud-Est les moyens de renforcer les ressources humaines et de renforcer la main-d'œuvre pour une surveillance et un contrôle plus efficaces des maladies. En utilisant une variété de formats de formation préalable et continue, y compris les clubs étudiants One Health et l'apprentissage expérientiel, OHW-NG favorise les compétences One Health.

title.narrative: Leadership, Interactions, Networks, and Knowledge (LINK) project

description.narrative: The Leadership, Interactions, Networks, and Knowledge (LINK) project plays an integral role in transforming agricultural policy systems worldwide, thereby improving food security outcomes in line with theU.S. Global Food Security Strategyand advancing countries on their journeys to self-reliance.Rather than developing policies or directing policy-making processes outright, LINK strengthens the capacity of local actors and institutions to lead agricultural transformation processes in their respective countries and regions. It builds on the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID)s and DAIs almost nine years of experience on theAfrica Leadership Training and Capacity Building Program (Africa Lead)andBuilding Capacity for African Agricultural Transformation (Africa Lead II).

description.narrative: Through DIMS3, the US Agency for International Development, Bureau of Latin America and the Caribbean, Office of Regional Sustainable Development, Democracy, Human Rights, and Governance team (USAID/LAC/RSD/DRG) aims to support citizen-responsive governance and democratic development with rigorous public opinion research on democratic norms, attitudes, and experiences in the Latin America and Caribbean (LAC) region. This will be achieved through four primary work streams: 1) collaborative, periodic, innovative public opinion surveys and research on democratic values, behaviors, and perceptions in LAC; 2) dissemination of data, analysis, and research about democratic norms and attitudes in LAC; 3) support and development of innovative topics and methodologies in public opinion research and analysis; and 4) building the local capacity of researchers and institutions on survey design, data collection, data analysis and reporting, and evidence based policy making. The foundation of these efforts is longitudinal, country, and comparative cross-national trend analysis on topics relevant to the democracy sector in LAC, such as democratic norms and values, perceptions of institutions, and experiences with corruption, crime victimization, and migration.

A través de DIMS3, el equipo de la Agencia de los Estados Unidos para el Desarrollo Internacional, la Oficina para América Latina y el Caribe, la Oficina Regional de Desarrollo Sostenible, Democracia, Derechos Humanos y Gobernanza (USAID/LAC/RSD/DRG) tiene como objetivo apoyar la gobernanza y el desarrollo democrático con capacidad de respuesta ciudadana con una rigurosa investigación de la opinión pública sobre las normas, actitudes y experiencias democráticas en la región de América Latina y el Caribe (LAC). Esto se logrará a través de cuatro líneas de trabajo principales: 1) investigaciones y encuestas de opinión pública colaborativas, periódicas e innovadoras sobre valores, comportamientos y percepciones democráticas en ALC; 2) difusión de datos, análisis e investigaciones sobre normas y actitudes democráticas en ALC; 3) apoyo y desarrollo de temas y metodologías innovadoras en la investigación y análisis de la opinión pública; y 4) desarrollar la capacidad local de investigadores e instituciones en diseño de encuestas, recopilación de datos, análisis e informes de datos y formulación de políticas basadas en evidencia. La base de estos esfuerzos es el análisis longitudinal, nacional y comparativo de tendencias transnacionales sobre temas relevantes para el sector de la democracia en ALC, como normas y valores democráticos, percepciones de las instituciones y experiencias con corrupción, victimización por delincuencia y migración.

title.narrative: Hearts of Europe

description.narrative: (Europe and Eurasia Regional): .Hearts of Europe strengthens communities, promotes free market values, and builds transatlantic economic ties. Hearts of Europe also contributes to CAATSA Goal 8 as negative influences and obstacles to private sector growth in the region are increasingly undermining public support for principles of free and fair market economies, which is a constraint to American businesses in the region. The Rotary Foundation is contributing matching funds of $1 million to the EE program under Hearts of Europe, which represents a true equal partnership with USAID...USAID is supporting demonstrations of the positive impact of a free market by promoting local economic and social development through business clubs committed to free market principles. Hearts of Europe supports this development objective by (1) strengthening the ability of local Rotary club members to implement visible projects that respond to community needs; (2) increasing engagement of local Rotary club members with U.S. Rotary club members to build people-to-people cooperative relationships and strengthen transatlantic networks; and (3) increasing interaction of local Rotary youth clubs with local business leaders to strengthen their professional networks and capacity as entrepreneurs..Under Hearts of Europe, local Rotary clubs are eligible to develop small sub-grant projects based on the results of community needs assessments. Sub-grant projects are to support local business clubs to demonstrate their positive engagement with local communities. These activities raise public support for free market principles and strengthen the role as U.S. business partners at the local level.

title.narrative: NPI SCOPE

description.narrative: (USAID Global Health (GH)): This is an award under NPI GH Round 1, Community Health Networks. It focuses on addressing key drivers of child and maternal morbidity and mortality by expanding the availability of, demand for, and utilization of high quality and high impact services addressing MNCH, voluntary FP/RH with possible work in nutrition, WASH practices, and infectious diseases. Women and children are greatly impacted in Haiti, Kenya, Malawi, and South Sudan where 170,000 maternal and child deaths occur annually. World Relief will expand its current efforts through the SCOPE project to reduce preventable maternal and child morbidity and mortality in these challenging health environments..The SCOPE project's strategic objectives are: 1) to increase utilization of reproductive health services for women of reproductive age, and 2) to increase utilization of primary health care services by children under five years. The SCOPE project seeks to use and improve existing private and public health systems, working with health service providers to train community health actors and strengthen policies to improve access to services. As a key partner, Christian Connections for International Health, will improve advocacy efforts at various levels of the four Ministries of Health through strong local partners -- churches, religious networks, and Christian Health Associations. These local partners are essential for SCOPE's collaboration, learning, and long-term sustainability.

title.narrative: Research for Scalable Solutions (R4S)
Recherche de solutions évolutives (R4S)

description.narrative: The overarching purpose of R4S is to strengthen generation and utilization of evidence to increase access to voluntary family planning and improve healthy timing and spacing of births. In order to achieve this purpose, R4S supports two key areas of work: 1) research to answer priority implementation science questions; and 2) technical assistance to build capacity for data analysis, evidence synthesis, and adoption of evidence-based practices. R4S has three key results areas: Result 1: Expanded development, adoption and implementation at scale of client-driven approaches. Result 2: Improved understanding of the cost-effectiveness and efficiency of scaling proven and promising service delivery practices. Result 3: Increased understanding of how proven and promising practices enhance equitable access to high-quality, voluntary family planning.

L’objectif primordial de R4S est de renforcer la production et l’utilisation de données probantes pour accroître l’accès à la planification familiale volontaire et améliorer le calendrier et l’espacement sains des naissances. Afin d'atteindre cet objectif, R4S soutient deux domaines de travail clés : 1) la recherche pour répondre aux questions scientifiques prioritaires de mise en œuvre ; et 2) une assistance technique pour renforcer les capacités d’analyse des données, de synthèse des données probantes et d’adoption de pratiques fondées sur des données probantes. R4S comporte trois domaines de résultats clés : Résultat 1 : développement, adoption et mise en œuvre élargis à l'échelle d'approches axées sur le client. Résultat 2 : Meilleure compréhension de la rentabilité et de l’efficacité de la mise à l’échelle des pratiques de prestation de services éprouvées et prometteuses. Résultat 3 : Meilleure compréhension de la manière dont les pratiques éprouvées et prometteuses améliorent l’accès équitable à une planification familiale volontaire de haute qualité.

title.narrative: Accelerating Support to Advanced Local Partners (ASAP)
Accélération du support aux partenaires locaux avancés (ASAP)
Acelerando o suporte para parceiros locais avançados (ASAP)

description.narrative: (Malawi): USAID/Malawi is implementing Government-to-Government agreements with Malawi's Ministry of Finance and ZDC and will be adding a second district - MDC. Jointly funded with PEPFAR, the funds channeled through these agreements will directly strengthen health human resources and service delivery activities in maternal and child health; nutrition; family planning; and HIV. USAID's Accelerating Support to Advanced Local Partners (ASAP) will build the capacity of the government in critical areas pertaining to the Implementation Letters with particular focus on implementing the Risk Mitigation Plan including strengthening the financial and administrative control environment and procedures to maximize aid effectiveness. ASAP will embed technical assistance to strengthen the government's financial management, audit readiness, human resources management, procurement systems, and program oversight. As a result, USAID will build capacity within the GoM to directly plan and manage its own development. ..The activity aligns with the Integrated Country Strategy Mission Objective 1.2 - Public service providers improve the integrity and quality of public services. The activity supports U.S. foreign assistance priorities to enhance long-term sustainability, increase efficiency, strengthen transparency, and promote accountability.....

(Malawi) : L'USAID/Malawi met en œuvre des accords de gouvernement à gouvernement avec le ministère des Finances du Malawi et le ZDC et ajoutera un deuxième district - MDC. Financés conjointement avec le PEPFAR, les fonds acheminés par le biais de ces accords renforceront directement les ressources humaines en santé et les activités de prestation de services en matière de santé maternelle et infantile ; nutrition; planification familiale; et le VIH. Le soutien accéléré de l'USAID aux partenaires locaux avancés (ASAP) renforcera les capacités du gouvernement dans les domaines critiques relatifs aux lettres de mise en œuvre, avec un accent particulier sur la mise en œuvre du plan d'atténuation des risques, y compris le renforcement de l'environnement et des procédures de contrôle financier et administratif pour maximiser l'efficacité de l'aide. L'ASAP intégrera une assistance technique pour renforcer la gestion financière du gouvernement, la préparation aux audits, la gestion des ressources humaines, les systèmes de passation des marchés et la surveillance des programmes. En conséquence, l’USAID renforcera les capacités au sein du GoM pour planifier et gérer directement son propre développement. ..L'activité s'aligne sur l'objectif 1.2 de la mission de la stratégie de pays intégrée - Les prestataires de services publics améliorent l'intégrité et la qualité des services publics. L'activité soutient les priorités de l'aide étrangère des États-Unis visant à améliorer la durabilité à long terme, à accroître l'efficacité, à renforcer la transparence et à promouvoir la responsabilité.....

(Malawi): A USAID/Malawi está a implementar acordos entre governos com o Ministério das Finanças do Malawi e a ZDC e irá adicionar um segundo distrito - MDC. Financiados conjuntamente com o PEPFAR, os fundos canalizados através destes acordos irão reforçar directamente os recursos humanos da saúde e as actividades de prestação de serviços na saúde materna e infantil; nutrição; planejamento familiar; e VIH. O Apoio Acelerado a Parceiros Locais Avançados (ASAP) da USAID irá reforçar a capacidade do governo em áreas críticas relacionadas com as Cartas de Implementação, com particular enfoque na implementação do Plano de Mitigação de Riscos, incluindo o fortalecimento do ambiente e procedimentos de controlo financeiro e administrativo para maximizar a eficácia da ajuda. A ASAP incorporará assistência técnica para fortalecer a gestão financeira do governo, a preparação para auditorias, a gestão de recursos humanos, os sistemas de aquisição e a supervisão do programa. Como resultado, a USAID criará capacidade dentro do GdM para planear e gerir directamente o seu próprio desenvolvimento. ..A atividade está alinhada com a Missão da Estratégia Integrada do País, Objetivo 1.2 - Os prestadores de serviços públicos melhoram a integridade e a qualidade dos serviços públicos. A atividade apoia as prioridades de assistência externa dos EUA para melhorar a sustentabilidade a longo prazo, aumentar a eficiência, fortalecer a transparência e promover a responsabilização.....

title.narrative: Fiscal Accountability and Sustainable Trade (FAST), PFM II IDIQ
Responsabilidad Fiscal y Comercio Sostenible (FAST), PFM II IDIQ

description.narrative: The Fiscal Accountability and Sustainable Trade (FAST) Task Order is tasked with supporting rapid, sustainable, and equitable economic growth in USAID-assisted countries by enabling USAID to bring a systems approach to addressing PFM, trade capacity building, macroeconomic planning and policies, and other economic governance issues. FAST will support missions to improve the following: host-country capacity to mobilize revenue and provide public services; policy climates for investment that generate more productive employment and inclusive growth; host-country ability to recover from, prevent, and/or mitigate the impact of conflict, natural disasters, or fiscal crises; and host-country institutional capacity to identify, design, advocate, and implement better economic policies to enhance inclusive growth and gender equity.

La Orden de Trabajo sobre Responsabilidad Fiscal y Comercio Sostenible (FAST) tiene la tarea de apoyar el crecimiento económico rápido, sostenible y equitativo en los países que reciben asistencia de USAID al permitir que USAID aporte un enfoque sistémico para abordar la GFP, la creación de capacidad comercial, la planificación y políticas macroeconómicas y otras cuestiones de gobernanza económica. FAST apoyará misiones para mejorar lo siguiente: la capacidad del país anfitrión para movilizar ingresos y proporcionar servicios públicos; climas políticos para la inversión que generen empleo más productivo y crecimiento inclusivo; la capacidad del país anfitrión para recuperarse, prevenir y/o mitigar el impacto de conflictos, desastres naturales o crisis fiscales; y capacidad institucional del país anfitrión para identificar, diseñar, promover e implementar mejores políticas económicas para mejorar el crecimiento inclusivo y la equidad de género.

title.narrative: Clean Cities, Blue Ocean (Buy-in)
Ciudades limpias, océano azul (compra)
Ciudades limpias, océano azul (compra)

description.narrative: (Philippines): .The Philippines is the third largest contributor to ocean plastic with an estimated 0.75 million metric tons of plastic entering the ocean every year. Waste management is typically the responsibility of the under-resourced local government units but the private sector is heavily invested in the entire plastic value chain and thus, can play an integral role in reducing and better managing plastic waste. ..Using FY 2021 funds, the Clean Cities, Blue Ocean (CCBO), USAID's flagship plastic waste pollution reduction program, will deepen partnership with city governments through the utilization of the Solid Waste Capacity Index for Local Governments tool. CCBO will expand interventions with current partner Cities Development Initiative sites and selected Metro Manila areas through its Grants component work. CCBO will intensify partnerships with the private sector and engage civil society organizations in its current sites of Batangas, Iloilo, and Puerto Princesa to address solid waste management (SWM) system concerns and plastic pollution reduction. Aside from the expansion of CCBO's work at the community level, the program will also increase its work at the national level providing technical assistance to the Department of Environment and Natural Resources and the National Solid Waste Management Commission in implementing the recently approved National Plan of Action on Marine Litter. In addition, CCBO will deliver technical assistance to the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority to improve its SWM system. Funding for this activity amounting to $3.2 million contributes to the total Ocean Plastics directive of $5 million..

(Filipinas): Filipinas es el tercer mayor contribuyente de plástico oceánico, con aproximadamente 0,75 millones de toneladas métricas de plástico que ingresan al océano cada año. La gestión de residuos suele ser responsabilidad de las unidades gubernamentales locales con recursos insuficientes, pero el sector privado ha invertido mucho en toda la cadena de valor del plástico y, por lo tanto, puede desempeñar un papel integral en la reducción y la mejor gestión de los residuos plásticos. ...Utilizando fondos del año fiscal 2021, Ciudades Limpias, Océano Azul (CCBO), el programa emblemático de reducción de la contaminación por desechos plásticos de USAID, profundizará la asociación con los gobiernos municipales mediante la utilización de la herramienta Índice de capacidad de desechos sólidos para gobiernos locales. CCBO ampliará las intervenciones con los sitios actuales asociados de la Iniciativa de Desarrollo de Ciudades y áreas seleccionadas de Metro Manila a través de su trabajo componente de Subvenciones. CCBO intensificará las asociaciones con el sector privado e involucrará a organizaciones de la sociedad civil en sus sitios actuales de Batangas, Iloilo y Puerto Princesa para abordar las preocupaciones del sistema de gestión de residuos sólidos (SWM) y la reducción de la contaminación plástica. Además de la expansión del trabajo de CCBO a nivel comunitario, el programa también aumentará su trabajo a nivel nacional brindando asistencia técnica al Departamento de Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales y a la Comisión Nacional de Manejo de Residuos Sólidos en la implementación del Plan Nacional de Acción sobre Basura Marina recientemente aprobado. Además, CCBO brindará asistencia técnica a la Autoridad de Desarrollo Metropolitana de Manila para mejorar su sistema de SWM. La financiación para esta actividad, que asciende a 3,2 millones de dólares, contribuye a la directiva total sobre plásticos oceánicos de 5 millones de dólares.

title.narrative: Program Design and Learning
Diseño y aprendizaje de programas
Design e aprendizagem do programa

description.narrative: This program area covers components of program design and performance management and learning. This area supports assessment, special studies and analysis, strategic planning, program and project design, program monitoring (to include baseline studies and other data collection needs) and activities that support learning, knowledge transfer and adaptation of projects. Assessment includes the examination of the state of a country or sector context to inform project design but does not include evaluation of USG-funded activities (please see Program Area PO.3 for a definition of evaluation). Special studies or analysis could support strategic or project planning or include research for general learning that is not necessarily related to the performance of USG-funded activities. This program area may also include the preparation of strategic plans and other short-term programming tasks, assessment of the potential of information and communication technologies to enhance performance throughout the program cycle or dissemination of best practices and lessons learned.

Esta área del programa cubre componentes de diseño de programas y gestión del desempeño y aprendizaje. Esta área apoya la evaluación, los estudios y análisis especiales, la planificación estratégica, el diseño de programas y proyectos, el seguimiento de programas (para incluir estudios de referencia y otras necesidades de recopilación de datos) y actividades que apoyan el aprendizaje, la transferencia de conocimientos y la adaptación de proyectos. La evaluación incluye el examen del estado de un contexto nacional o sectorial para informar el diseño del proyecto, pero no incluye la evaluación de las actividades financiadas por el Gobierno de los Estados Unidos (consulte el Área programática PO.3 para obtener una definición de evaluación). Estudios o análisis especiales podrían respaldar la planificación estratégica o de proyectos o incluir investigaciones para el aprendizaje general que no esté necesariamente relacionado con el desempeño de las actividades financiadas por el Gobierno de los Estados Unidos. Esta área programática también puede incluir la preparación de planes estratégicos y otras tareas de programación a corto plazo, la evaluación del potencial de las tecnologías de la información y las comunicaciones para mejorar el desempeño a lo largo del ciclo del programa o la difusión de mejores prácticas y lecciones aprendidas.

Esta área programática cobre componentes de concepção de programas e gestão de desempenho e aprendizagem. Esta área apoia a avaliação, estudos e análises especiais, planeamento estratégico, concepção de programas e projectos, monitorização de programas (para incluir estudos de base e outras necessidades de recolha de dados) e actividades que apoiam a aprendizagem, transferência de conhecimentos e adaptação de projectos. A avaliação inclui o exame do estado de um país ou contexto sectorial para informar a concepção do projecto, mas não inclui a avaliação das actividades financiadas pelo Governo dos EUA (ver Área Programática PO.3 para uma definição de avaliação). Estudos ou análises especiais poderiam apoiar o planeamento estratégico ou de projectos ou incluir investigação para aprendizagem geral que não esteja necessariamente relacionada com o desempenho de actividades financiadas pelo Governo dos EUA. Esta área programática também pode incluir a preparação de planos estratégicos e outras tarefas de programação de curto prazo, a avaliação do potencial das tecnologias de informação e comunicação para melhorar o desempenho ao longo do ciclo do programa ou a divulgação de melhores práticas e lições aprendidas.

description.narrative: Engaging PMI Measure Malaria enables organizations to draw on the technical and administrative resources of a global, centrally funded project. title.narrative: Food Security Policy Research, Capacity and Influence (FS-PRCI)
Pesquisa, Capacidade e Influência em Políticas de Segurança Alimentar (FS-PRCI)

description.narrative: The Feed the Future Innovation Lab for Food Security Policy Research, Capacity, and Influence is supported by USAIDs Bureau for Resilience and Food Security (RFS). A collaborative effort among consortium partners that seeks to enhance the ability of local policy research organizations to conduct high-quality food security policy research and influence food security policy more effectively while becoming increasingly self-reliant.

O Laboratório de Inovação Feed the Future para Pesquisa, Capacidade e Influência de Políticas de Segurança Alimentar é apoiado pelo Bureau de Resiliência e Segurança Alimentar (RFS) da USAID. Um esforço colaborativo entre parceiros do consórcio que procura melhorar a capacidade das organizações de investigação política local para realizarem investigação política de segurança alimentar de alta qualidade e influenciarem a política de segurança alimentar de forma mais eficaz, ao mesmo tempo que se tornam cada vez mais autossuficientes.

usg:treasury-account.usg:main-account: Assistance for Europe, Eurasia and Central Asia (AEECA)
Assistance for Europe, Eurasia and Central Asia (AEECA)

title.narrative: I - New Partnership Initiative APS

description.narrative: (LAB - Global Development Lab): The program is in Central Asia and Afghanistan to serves as an initial foray into reconnecting communities to demonstrate secure legal investment and ties can help localities begin to flourish. With this demonstration, follow-on efforts could be programmed to nurture further broader cross-border development. In the absence of a new funded initiative as this, with clear financial support from the US Government, it is not evident that border communities will spontaneously create these opportunities by themselves..

Assistance for Europe, Eurasia and Central Asia (AEECA)

title.narrative: Feed the Future Knowledge, Data, Learning, and Training (KDLT)

description.narrative: The Feed the Future Knowledge, Data, Learning, and Training (KDLT) contract is a five-year activity designed to expand the USAID Bureau for Food Security (BFS) and Feed the Futures capacity and quality of knowledge sharing, data management and analysis, organizational learning, and training. Bixal will focus on helping BFS continue its evolution as a leading knowledge sharing and learning organization with the capacity to collaborate with Feed the Future missions, implementing partners, and others to achieve better development results. KDLT will focus on five key results: Improved and sustained capacity for knowledge sharing; Expanded capacity for on-demand, accurate data analysis and visualization; Maintenance, growth, and improvement in USAID web platforms and databases; Increased awareness and use of new evidence and learnings to influence programmatic procurement and decision-making; Improved culture of collaboration, knowledge-sharing, learning, and adapting among USAID staff, Feed the Future Missions, and Feed the Future implementing partners.

description.narrative: The GITA II Task Order makes available global, on-demand, rapid-response, short-term technical assistance (STTA) on gender integration to USAID Missions and Bureaus across multiple sectors and in crisis and non-crisis settings. It applies expertise in gender research and practice to the process of designing, implementing, monitoring, and evaluating USAID strategies, projects, and activities to reduce the gender and womens empowerment gaps that impede development outcomes. Assignments include carrying out county-level gender and social inclusion analyses and assessments to inform USAID Country Development Cooperation Strategies, as well as more specific work on gender-based violence (GBV) or other priority themes related to gender equality and womens empowerment.

L'ordre de travail GITA II met à disposition une assistance technique (STTA) mondiale, à la demande, à réponse rapide et à court terme sur l'intégration du genre aux missions et bureaux de l'USAID dans plusieurs secteurs et dans des contextes de crise et de non-crise. Il applique son expertise en matière de recherche et de pratique sur le genre au processus de conception, de mise en œuvre, de suivi et d'évaluation des stratégies, des projets et des activités de l'USAID visant à réduire les écarts entre les sexes et l'autonomisation des femmes qui entravent les résultats du développement. Les missions comprennent la réalisation d'analyses et d'évaluations sur le genre et l'inclusion sociale au niveau des comtés pour éclairer les stratégies de coopération au développement des pays de l'USAID, ainsi que des travaux plus spécifiques sur la violence basée sur le genre (VBG) ou d'autres thèmes prioritaires liés à l'égalité des sexes et à l'autonomisation des femmes.

La Orden de Trabajo GITA II pone a disposición asistencia técnica global, bajo demanda, de respuesta rápida y de corto plazo (STTA) sobre integración de género para las Misiones y Oficinas de USAID en múltiples sectores y en entornos de crisis y no crisis. Aplica su experiencia en investigación y práctica de género al proceso de diseño, implementación, seguimiento y evaluación de estrategias, proyectos y actividades de USAID para reducir las brechas de género y empoderamiento de las mujeres que impiden los resultados de desarrollo. Las asignaciones incluyen la realización de análisis y evaluaciones de inclusión social y de género a nivel de condado para informar las estrategias de cooperación para el desarrollo de países de USAID, así como un trabajo más específico sobre violencia de género (VBG) u otros temas prioritarios relacionados con la igualdad de género y el empoderamiento de las mujeres.

description.narrative: USAIDs YouthPower Learning project closed major knowledge gaps in PYD theory and practice, yet there is a continuing need to build, expand, and disseminate PYD evidence and learning more widely across multiple sectors. USAIDs Journey to Self-Reliance agenda requires a fresh perspective and forward-looking approaches to achieve systems change through effective integration of PYD principles and frameworks into local community and host-government strategies.

Le projet YouthPower Learning de l'USAID a comblé d'importantes lacunes dans les connaissances sur la théorie et la pratique du PYD, mais il existe un besoin continu de construire, d'élargir et de diffuser plus largement les preuves et l'apprentissage du PYD dans de multiples secteurs. Le programme Journey to Self-Reliance de l'USAID nécessite une nouvelle perspective et des approches tournées vers l'avenir pour parvenir à un changement de système grâce à l'intégration efficace des principes et des cadres du PYD dans les stratégies de la communauté locale et du gouvernement hôte.

title.narrative: New Partnership Initiative (NPI) Incubator
Incubadora de Nuevas Iniciativas de Asociación (NPI).
Incubadora de Nuevas Iniciativas de Asociación (NPI).

Incubadora de Nuevas Iniciativas de Asociación (NPI).

description.narrative: The NPI Incubator will develop resources and training for local and underutilized groups, including faith-based, community, and civil-society organizations, so they can successfully compete for USAID contracts, agreements, and grants. The NPI Incubator will provide a self-assessment tool for new and underutilized organizations to better understand context-specific barriers that prevent them from working with USAID. The Incubator will serve as a global service hub, providing resources for organizations to overcome barriers and implement effective programs.

La Incubadora NPI desarrollará recursos y capacitación para grupos locales y subutilizados, incluidas organizaciones religiosas, comunitarias y de la sociedad civil, para que puedan competir con éxito por contratos, acuerdos y subvenciones de USAID. La Incubadora NPI proporcionará una herramienta de autoevaluación para que organizaciones nuevas y subutilizadas comprendan mejor las barreras específicas del contexto que les impiden trabajar con USAID. La Incubadora servirá como un centro de servicios global, proporcionando recursos para que las organizaciones superen barreras e implementen programas efectivos.

title.narrative: Feed the Future Market Systems and Partnerships activity (MSP)
Nourrir l’activité Systèmes de Marché et Partenariats du Futur (MSP)
Nourrir l’activité Systèmes de Marché et Partenariats du Futur (MSP)
Nourrir l’activité Systèmes de Marché et Partenariats du Futur (MSP)
Actividad de Alimentar la actividad de asociaciones y sistemas de mercado del futuro (MSP)
Alimentar a atividade de Sistemas e Parcerias de Mercado Futuro (MSP)

description.narrative: The Feed the Future Market Systems and Partnerships activity (MSP) helps the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) advance learning and good practice in integrating private sector engagement across all activities, while at the same time deepening market systems development across the Feed the Future program cycle. MSP supports USAID and its implementers to deliver durable, systemic, and inclusive agriculture-led growth that results in more dynamic agriculture and food market systems, improved food security and nutrition, and sustained poverty reduction. MSP strengthens practical guidance for market systems development including how to translate theory into practice, builds the evidence base on market systems development impact, and strengthens the tools for measuring systemic change. MSP uses an agile operational approach that captures and communicates innovation, builds broad internal and external stakeholder capacity, and nurtures transformationaland nottransactional partnerships between USAID and the private sector.

L’activité Feed the Future Market Systems and Partnerships (MSP) aide l’Agence américaine pour le développement international (USAID) à faire progresser l’apprentissage et les bonnes pratiques en intégrant l’engagement du secteur privé dans toutes les activités, tout en approfondissant le développement des systèmes de marché tout au long du cycle du programme Feed the Future. MSP soutient l’USAID et ses exécutants pour assurer une croissance durable, systémique et inclusive tirée par l’agriculture qui se traduit par des systèmes agricoles et de marché alimentaire plus dynamiques, une amélioration de la sécurité alimentaire et de la nutrition et une réduction durable de la pauvreté. Le MSP renforce les orientations pratiques pour le développement des systèmes de marché, notamment sur la manière de traduire la théorie en pratique, construit la base de données factuelles sur l’impact du développement des systèmes de marché et renforce les outils de mesure du changement systémique. MSP utilise une approche opérationnelle agile qui capture et communique l'innovation, renforce les capacités des parties prenantes internes et externes et entretient des partenariats transformationnels et non transactionnels entre l'USAID et le secteur privé.

MSP soutient l’USAID et ses exécutants pour assurer une croissance durable, systémique et inclusive tirée par l’agriculture qui se traduit par des systèmes agricoles et de marché alimentaire plus dynamiques, une amélioration de la sécurité alimentaire et de la nutrition et une réduction durable de la pauvreté. Le MSP renforce les orientations pratiques pour le développement des systèmes de marché, notamment sur la manière de traduire la théorie en pratique, construit la base de données factuelles sur l’impact du développement des systèmes de marché et renforce les outils de mesure du changement systémique. La actividad Feed the Future Market Systems and Partnerships (MSP) ayuda a la Agencia de los Estados Unidos para el Desarrollo Internacional (USAID) a avanzar en el aprendizaje y las buenas prácticas para integrar la participación del sector privado en todas las actividades, al tiempo que profundiza el desarrollo de sistemas de mercado en todo el ciclo del programa Feed the Future. MSP apoya a USAID y sus implementadores para lograr un crecimiento impulsado por la agricultura duradero, sistémico e inclusivo que resulte en sistemas de mercado agrícola y alimentario más dinámicos, mejor seguridad alimentaria y nutrición, y una reducción sostenida de la pobreza. MSP fortalece la orientación práctica para el desarrollo de sistemas de mercado, incluida cómo traducir la teoría a la práctica, construye la base de evidencia sobre el impacto del desarrollo de sistemas de mercado y fortalece las herramientas para medir el cambio sistémico. MSP utiliza un enfoque operativo ágil que captura y comunica la innovación, crea una amplia capacidad de las partes interesadas internas y externas y fomenta asociaciones transformadoras y no transaccionales entre USAID y el sector privado.

A atividade Feed the Future Market Systems and Partnerships (MSP) ajuda a Agência dos EUA para o Desenvolvimento Internacional (USAID) a promover a aprendizagem e as boas práticas na integração do envolvimento do setor privado em todas as atividades, ao mesmo tempo que aprofunda o desenvolvimento de sistemas de mercado em todo o ciclo do programa Feed the Future. O MSP apoia a USAID e os seus implementadores para proporcionar um crescimento sustentável, sistémico e inclusivo liderado pela agricultura que resulte em sistemas agrícolas e de mercado alimentar mais dinâmicos, melhor segurança alimentar e nutrição e redução sustentada da pobreza. O MSP reforça a orientação prática para o desenvolvimento de sistemas de mercado, incluindo como traduzir a teoria em prática, constrói a base de evidências sobre o impacto do desenvolvimento de sistemas de mercado e fortalece as ferramentas para medir a mudança sistémica. O MSP utiliza uma abordagem operacional ágil que captura e comunica a inovação, desenvolve ampla capacidade das partes interessadas internas e externas e estimula parcerias transformacionais e não transacionais entre a USAID e o setor privado.

title.narrative: MOMENTUM 2A - Global Technical Leadership and Targeted Technical Assistance for MNCH/FP/RH
MOMENTUM 2A - Leadership technique mondial et assistance technique ciblée pour la SMNI/PF/SR
MOMENTUM 2A - Liderança Técnica Global e Assistência Técnica Direcionada para SMNI/PF/SR

description.narrative: The suite of MOMENTUM awards seeks to accelerate reductions in maternal, newborn, and child mortality and morbidity in high-burden, USAID-supported countries by increasing the capacity of host country institutions and local organizations to introduce, deliver, scale up, and sustain the use of evidence-based, quality maternal, newborn, and child health (MNCH) services, voluntary family planning (FP), and reproductive health (RH) care. MOMENTUM Round 2A (project name TBD) is focused on (1) providing targeted technical assistance and capacity-development to USAID s Missions, partner governments, and local organizations; and, (2) contributing to global technical leadership and policy dialogue on improving measurable outcomes for reproductive; maternal, newborn, and child health; and voluntary family planning.

La série de prix MOMENTUM vise à accélérer la réduction de la mortalité et de la morbidité maternelles, néonatales et infantiles dans les pays à forte charge de morbidité soutenus par l'USAID en augmentant la capacité des institutions du pays hôte et des organisations locales à introduire, fournir, intensifier et maintenir l'utilisation de services de santé maternelle, néonatale et infantile (SMNI) de qualité, fondés sur des données probantes, de planification familiale volontaire (PF) et de soins de santé reproductive (SR). MOMENTUM Round 2A (nom du projet à déterminer) se concentre sur (1) la fourniture d'une assistance technique ciblée et le développement des capacités aux missions de l'USAID, aux gouvernements partenaires et aux organisations locales ; et (2) contribuer au leadership technique mondial et au dialogue politique sur l'amélioration des résultats mesurables en matière de reproduction ; santé maternelle, néonatale et infantile ; et la planification familiale volontaire.

O conjunto de prémios MOMENTUM procura acelerar as reduções na mortalidade e morbilidade materna, neonatal e infantil em países de elevada carga apoiados pela USAID, aumentando a capacidade das instituições do país anfitrião e das organizações locais para introduzir, fornecer, ampliar e sustentar a utilização de serviços de saúde materna, neonatal e infantil (SMNI) de qualidade, baseados em evidências, cuidados de planeamento familiar voluntário (PF) e de saúde reprodutiva (SR). A Ronda 2A do MOMENTUM (nome do projecto a definir) centra-se em (1) fornecer assistência técnica direccionada e desenvolvimento de capacidades às missões da USAID, governos parceiros e organizações locais; e (2) contribuir para a liderança técnica global e o diálogo político sobre a melhoria de resultados mensuráveis ​​para a reprodução; saúde materna, neonatal e infantil; e planejamento familiar voluntário.

description.narrative: MOMENTUM Round 1 will support countries seeking to overcome the impacts of fragility on the population s health. At the country or community level, Round 1 seeks to reduce maternal and child mortality and increase self-reliance and resilience through service delivery, technical assistance and development and application of global and country specific learnings and best practices. At the global level, MOMENTUM Round 1 will contribute to the nascent learning on best practices and approaches for strengthening health service delivery and building resilience in fragile settings through the development and implementation of a robust learning agenda.

Le premier cycle MOMENTUM soutiendra les pays qui cherchent à surmonter les impacts de la fragilité sur la santé de la population. Au niveau national ou communautaire, le premier cycle vise à réduire la mortalité maternelle et infantile et à accroître l'autonomie et la résilience grâce à la prestation de services, à l'assistance technique et au développement et à l'application des enseignements et des meilleures pratiques spécifiques au monde et au pays. Au niveau mondial, MOMENTUM Round 1 contribuera à l'apprentissage naissant sur les meilleures pratiques et approches pour renforcer la prestation de services de santé et renforcer la résilience dans les contextes fragiles grâce à l'élaboration et à la mise en œuvre d'un programme d'apprentissage solide.

title.narrative: NPI Community Partnerships for Respectful Care (CPRC)

description.narrative: (USAID Global Health (GH)): .This project is under the GH NPI APS, Round 1, Community Health Networks. This project will be focussed on Liberia and Tanzania and will build on USAID support in the RMNCH sector, building upon past gains, align with ongoing programs, and address remaining gaps specific to respectful health care, all while working through underutilized partners whose potential to influence societal norms related to RMC that may have yet to be harnessed. This project will address both the supply and demand side of maternal health care service delivery through a community-level health intervention model. Americares and their partners will support those providing skilled care, aiming to improve the quality of care and increase the number of women delivering with a skilled birth attendant, as well as accessing other essential services such as family planning, newborn and child health services and nutrition outreach. They will work with civil society, religious partners and other community groups, as well as government authorities at the relevant region/ county and district levels, to understand and address the barriers to seeking care from the client perspective. In support of each country's Journey to Self-Reliance, the project will also improve capacity of local partners. This project includes the participation of three faith-based health networks: the U.S. -based Christian Connections for International Health (CCIH), the Liberia-based Christian Health Association of Liberia (CHAL), and the Tanzania-based Christian Social Services Commission..

description.narrative: MOMENTUM Private Healthcare Delivery. This is the fourth in a series of global health awards to accelerate reductions in maternal, newborn, and child mortality and morbidity in high-burden countries. This award falls under the MOMENTUM suite of projects, which aim to increase the capacity of host-government institutions and local non-governmental organizations to introduce, deliver, scale-up, and sustain the use of evidence-based, high-quality maternal, reproductive, newborn, and child health care and voluntary family planning.

Prestation de soins de santé privés MOMENTUM. Il s'agit du quatrième prix d'une série de prix de santé mondiaux visant à accélérer la réduction de la mortalité et de la morbidité maternelles, néonatales et infantiles dans les pays à forte charge de morbidité. Ce prix s'inscrit dans le cadre de la série de projets MOMENTUM, qui visent à accroître la capacité des institutions gouvernementales hôtes et des organisations non gouvernementales locales à introduire, fournir, intensifier et maintenir l'utilisation de soins de santé maternelle, reproductive, néonatale et infantile de haute qualité et fondés sur des données probantes, ainsi que de planification familiale volontaire.

Este é o quarto de uma série de prémios de saúde globais para acelerar a redução da mortalidade e morbilidade materna, neonatal e infantil em países com elevada carga. Este prêmio se enquadra no conjunto de projetos MOMENTUM, que visam aumentar a capacidade das instituições governamentais anfitriãs e das organizações não governamentais locais para introduzir, fornecer, ampliar e sustentar o uso de cuidados de saúde materna, reprodutiva, neonatal e infantil de alta qualidade, baseados em evidências, e planejamento familiar voluntário.

description.narrative: (Democratic Republic of the Congo): The USAID Country Health Information Systems and Data Use (CHISU) Activity will provide technical assistance, training, equipment, and supplies to the National Malaria Control Program (NMCP) to strengthen the monitoring and evaluation skills of its staff. FY 2022 funds will build capacity within the NMCP to conduct surveillance on core malaria interventions using high quality data from both surveys and health information systems. The activity will support the central and provincial levels of the DRC government in collecting, analyzing, and disseminating data. It will also provide malaria management training for health zone officers in selected geographic areas. This activity will enable the NMCP and its partners to improve the availability, timeliness, completeness, quality, and use of data related to providing quality malaria services in the DRC...These data are essential for the Government of the DRC to make informed, evidence-based decisions about how and where to target limited resources to maximize impact for preventing maternal and child deaths due to malaria. Healthy women and children contribute to more stable, resilient communities to the benefit of U.S. national security. Promoting the collection and use of quality data, moreover, is critical to ensuring the effectiveness of U.S. government investments and data-driven accountability to the U.S. taxpayer...This activity will contribute to Mission Objective 4.1 (Strengthen institutional and community capacity to prevent outbreaks from becoming pandemics as well as respond to and overcome frequent public health and humanitarian emergencies). This activity is part of the U.S. President's Malaria Initiative, a U.S. government priority..

(République démocratique du Congo) : L'activité des systèmes d'information et d'utilisation des données sanitaires nationales de l'USAID (CHISU) fournira une assistance technique, une formation, des équipements et des fournitures au Programme national de lutte contre le paludisme (PNLP) pour renforcer les compétences de suivi et d'évaluation de son personnel. Les fonds de l’exercice 2022 renforceront les capacités du PNLP à effectuer une surveillance des principales interventions antipaludiques en utilisant des données de haute qualité provenant d’enquêtes et de systèmes d’information sanitaire. L'activité soutiendra les niveaux central et provincial du gouvernement de la RDC dans la collecte, l'analyse et la diffusion des données. Il offrira également une formation à la gestion du paludisme aux agents des zones de santé dans des zones géographiques sélectionnées. Cette activité permettra au PNLP et à ses partenaires d'améliorer la disponibilité, l'actualité, l'exhaustivité, la qualité et l'utilisation des données liées à la fourniture de services de qualité contre le paludisme en RDC... Ces données sont essentielles pour que le gouvernement de la RDC puisse prendre des décisions éclairées et fondées sur des preuves sur comment et où cibler des ressources limitées pour maximiser l'impact de la prévention des décès maternels et infantiles dus au paludisme. Des femmes et des enfants en bonne santé contribuent à rendre les communautés plus stables et plus résilientes, au bénéfice de la sécurité nationale des États-Unis. En outre, promouvoir la collecte et l'utilisation de données de qualité est essentiel pour garantir l'efficacité des investissements du gouvernement américain et la responsabilité fondée sur les données envers le contribuable américain... Cette activité contribuera à l'objectif de mission 4.1 (Renforcer la capacité institutionnelle et communautaire pour empêcher les épidémies de se transformer en pandémies ainsi que pour répondre et surmonter les urgences de santé publique et humanitaires fréquentes). Cette activité fait partie de l'Initiative du Président américain contre le paludisme, une priorité du gouvernement américain..

title.narrative: Momentum 3B: Overcoming Entrenched Obstacles in Routine Immunization
Momentum 3B : Surmonter les obstacles tenaces dans la vaccination de routine
Momentum 3B : Surmonter les obstacles tenaces dans la vaccination de routine

Momentum 3B: Superando Obstáculos Arraigados na Imunização de Rotina

description.narrative: A cooperative agreement from the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) that will strengthen immunization programs around the world by identifying and removing persistent bottlenecks and barriers to planning, delivery, demand, and uptake of immunization services. This new award falls under USAIDs MOMENTUM suite of projects and will strengthen routine immunization programs and mitigate disruption of immunization services due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It will also help countries prepare for the future introduction and delivery of COVID-19 vaccines.

Un accord de coopération de l'Agence américaine pour le développement international (USAID) qui renforcera les programmes de vaccination dans le monde entier en identifiant et en supprimant les goulots d'étranglement et les obstacles persistants à la planification, à la prestation, à la demande et à l'adoption des services de vaccination. Ce nouveau prix s'inscrit dans le cadre de la série de projets MOMENTUM de l'USAID et renforcera les programmes de vaccination de routine et atténuera la perturbation des services de vaccination due à la pandémie de COVID-19. Cela aidera également les pays à se préparer à l'introduction et à la livraison futures des vaccins contre la COVID-19.

Um acordo de cooperação da Agência dos EUA para o Desenvolvimento Internacional (USAID) que reforçará os programas de imunização em todo o mundo, identificando e eliminando estrangulamentos e barreiras persistentes ao planeamento, prestação, procura e utilização de serviços de imunização. Este novo prémio enquadra-se no conjunto de projectos MOMENTUM da USAID e irá fortalecer os programas de imunização de rotina e mitigar a interrupção dos serviços de imunização devido à pandemia da COVID-19. Também ajudará os países a prepararem-se para a futura introdução e distribuição de vacinas contra a COVID-19.

title.narrative: Higher Education for Leadership, Innovation and Exchange - Supporting Holistic and Actionable Research in Education program (HELIX-SHARE)
Enseignement supérieur pour le leadership, l'innovation et l'échange - Programme de soutien à la recherche holistique et exploitable en éducation (HELIX-SHARE)
Educación superior para el liderazgo, la innovación y el intercambio: apoyo al programa de investigación holística y práctica en educación (HELIX-SHARE)

description.narrative: A five-year program to advance U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) learning priorities in the global education sector. The Higher Education for Leadership, Innovation and Exchange Supporting Holistic and Actionable Research in Education program, funded by USAID, will strengthen research capacity and knowledge translation to fill critical gaps in the education sector. While progress has been made in recent years to conduct research that strengthens education systems in developing countries, more targeted research is required to create systemic and sustainable change. This program, called HELIX SHARE, will bring local scholars and higher education institutions together to address these challenges and opportunities in a number of low- and middle-income countries, with a view to developing a replicable model to guide decision-makers.

Un programme quinquennal visant à faire progresser les priorités d'apprentissage de l'Agence américaine pour le développement international (USAID) dans le secteur de l'éducation mondiale. Le programme d’enseignement supérieur pour le leadership, l’innovation et les échanges soutenant la recherche holistique et exploitable en éducation, financé par l’USAID, renforcera les capacités de recherche et d’application des connaissances pour combler les lacunes critiques du secteur de l’éducation. Même si des progrès ont été réalisés ces dernières années dans la conduite de recherches visant à renforcer les systèmes éducatifs dans les pays en développement, des recherches plus ciblées sont nécessaires pour créer un changement systémique et durable. Ce programme, appelé HELIX SHARE, réunira des universitaires locaux et des établissements d'enseignement supérieur pour relever ces défis et opportunités dans un certain nombre de pays à revenu faible et intermédiaire, en vue de développer un modèle reproductible pour guider les décideurs.

Un programa de cinco años para promover las prioridades de aprendizaje de la Agencia de los Estados Unidos para el Desarrollo Internacional (USAID) en el sector educativo global. El programa de Educación Superior para el Liderazgo, la Innovación y el Intercambio que Apoya la Investigación Holística y Accionable en Educación, financiado por USAID, fortalecerá la capacidad de investigación y la traducción de conocimientos para llenar vacíos críticos en el sector educativo. Si bien en los últimos años se han logrado avances en la realización de investigaciones que fortalezcan los sistemas educativos en los países en desarrollo, se requiere una investigación más específica para crear un cambio sistémico y sostenible. Este programa, llamado HELIX SHARE, reunirá a académicos locales e instituciones de educación superior para abordar estos desafíos y oportunidades en varios países de ingresos bajos y medianos, con miras a desarrollar un modelo replicable para guiar a los tomadores de decisiones.

title.narrative: Promoting human rights in Cuba
Promoción de los derechos humanos en Cuba

description.narrative: Promote awareness of Cubas growing community of democracy activists, those laboring peacefully for a democratic opening, and respect for human rights. Connect Cubans to each other and to the outside world and support them becoming more informed citizens. The program will help them overcome the absence of free press, the lack of internet infrastructure, and the high cost of internal and external communications. The activity supports interaction among Cubans around social, cultural, and civic themes. By building citizens familiarity with civic participation, the activity creates awareness of what citizens can do to improve their local communities and hold public officials accountable, as well as help Cubans and civil society groups find ways to discuss everyday problems and propose ways to solve them.

Promover la conciencia sobre la creciente comunidad cubana de activistas por la democracia, aquellos que trabajan pacíficamente por una apertura democrática y el respeto a los derechos humanos. Conectar a los cubanos entre sí y con el mundo exterior y apoyarlos para que se conviertan en ciudadanos más informados. El programa les ayudará a superar la ausencia de prensa libre, la falta de infraestructura de Internet y el alto costo de las comunicaciones internas y externas. La actividad apoya la interacción entre los cubanos en torno a temas sociales, culturales y cívicos. Al familiarizar a los ciudadanos con la participación cívica, la actividad crea conciencia sobre lo que los ciudadanos pueden hacer para mejorar sus comunidades locales y responsabilizar a los funcionarios públicos, así como ayudar a los cubanos y a los grupos de la sociedad civil a encontrar formas de discutir los problemas cotidianos y proponer formas de resolverlos.

title.narrative: Health Systems for Tuberculosis (HS4TB)

description.narrative: Health Systems for Tuberculosis (HS4TB) is a five-year contract that will leverage MSHs successful leadership development programs to improve local governance and management skills in a TB Sector Transformation Program. HS4TB will focus on health systems priorities that most directly support achievement of TB outcomes, with a focus on health financing and governance in 23 USAID priority countries. The project will help countries increase domestic financing, use key TB resources more efficiently, build in-country technical and managerial competence and leadership, and support policy formation and dissemination. HS4TB will also prepare local organizations to transition into the role of primary technical assistance providers and recipients of direct donor support and will engage marginalized groups, including women and youth, in co-creating activities with national TB programs, professional associations, civil society, and other stakeholders.

description.narrative: The Integrated Natural Resource Management (INRM) activity provides on-demand support services and technical assistance for USAID Missions, Bureaus, and Independent Offices across a wide array of environmental and natural resource management issues. INRM covers the full range of environmental issues USAID works on and is managed jointly by the USAID E3 Offices of Land and Urban, Forestry and Biodiversity, and Global Climate Change. The activity is designed to help USAID operating units achieve higher impact environment programming and to support the uptake of principles and approaches outlined in the Agencys Environmental and Natural Resource Management (ENRM) Framework.

L'activité de gestion intégrée des ressources naturelles (INRM) fournit des services de soutien à la demande et une assistance technique aux missions, bureaux et bureaux indépendants de l'USAID sur un large éventail de questions de gestion de l'environnement et des ressources naturelles. L'INRM couvre toute la gamme des questions environnementales sur lesquelles l'USAID travaille et est géré conjointement par les bureaux E3 de l'USAID pour les terres et l'urbanisme, la foresterie et la biodiversité, et le changement climatique mondial. L'activité est conçue pour aider les unités opérationnelles de l'USAID à réaliser des programmes environnementaux à plus fort impact et à soutenir l'adoption des principes et des approches décrits dans le cadre de gestion de l'environnement et des ressources naturelles (ENRM) de l'agence.

La actividad de Gestión Integrada de Recursos Naturales (INRM) proporciona servicios de apoyo y asistencia técnica a pedido para las Misiones, Oficinas y Oficinas Independientes de USAID en una amplia gama de cuestiones ambientales y de gestión de recursos naturales. INRM cubre toda la gama de cuestiones ambientales en las que trabaja USAID y es administrado conjuntamente por las Oficinas E3 de Tierras y Urbanismo, Silvicultura y Biodiversidad y Cambio Climático Global de USAID. La actividad está diseñada para ayudar a las unidades operativas de USAID a lograr una programación ambiental de mayor impacto y para apoyar la adopción de principios y enfoques descritos en el Marco de Gestión Ambiental y de Recursos Naturales (ENRM) de las agencias.

A actividade de Gestão Integrada de Recursos Naturais (INRM) fornece serviços de apoio a pedido e assistência técnica para missões, gabinetes e escritórios independentes da USAID numa vasta gama de questões de gestão ambiental e de recursos naturais. O INRM cobre toda a gama de questões ambientais nas quais a USAID trabalha e é gerido conjuntamente pelos Escritórios E3 de Terra e Urbanismo, Silvicultura e Biodiversidade da USAID e Mudanças Climáticas Globais. A actividade destina-se a ajudar as unidades operacionais da USAID a alcançar uma programação ambiental de maior impacto e a apoiar a aceitação dos princípios e abordagens delineados no Quadro de Gestão Ambiental e de Recursos Naturais (ENRM) da Agência.

title.narrative: LACLEARN
LACLEARN
LACLEARN

description.narrative: The Latin America and Caribbean Learning and Rapid Response Task Order (LACLEARN), under the Analytical Services IV (ASIV) Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity Contract (IDIQ), will contribute to improving USAIDs Democracy, Human Rights, and Governance (DRG)1work in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) through two primary work streams: 1) state-of-the-art, gender-informed analytical work, assessments, research and special studies; results management support; and training that contribute to sector learning in the region and build an evidence base for effective programing, and 2) targeted short-term technical and analytical activities in transition environments that require rapid response programming support until other funds, mechanisms, and actors can be mobilized. The scope of these two work streams is across all DRG subsectors, including DRG sector aspects of citizen security and violence prevention, and the integration of DRG principles and cross cutting issues (gender, human rights, inclusive development) in other development sectors in the region. These activities support LAC/RSDs goal of advancing stability and social inclusion in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) by supporting stronger governance, democratic practices and values, and safer communities for citizens.

La Orden de Trabajo de Aprendizaje y Respuesta Rápida para América Latina y el Caribe (LACLEARN), en virtud del Contrato de Entrega Indefinida/Cantidad Indefinida (IDIQ) de Servicios Analíticos IV (ASIV), contribuirá a mejorar el trabajo de Democracia, Derechos Humanos y Gobernanza (DRG)1 de USAID en América Latina y el Caribe (LAC) a través de dos líneas de trabajo principales: 1) trabajos analíticos, evaluaciones, investigaciones y estudios especiales de última generación con perspectiva de género; apoyo a la gestión de resultados; y capacitación que contribuyan al aprendizaje sectorial en la región y creen una base de evidencia para una programación efectiva, y 2) actividades técnicas y analíticas específicas de corto plazo en entornos de transición que requieren apoyo de programación de respuesta rápida hasta que se puedan movilizar otros fondos, mecanismos y actores. El alcance de estas dos líneas de trabajo abarca todos los subsectores de los GRD, incluidos los aspectos sectoriales de los GRD de seguridad ciudadana y prevención de la violencia, y la integración de los principios de los GRD y las cuestiones transversales (género, derechos humanos, desarrollo inclusivo) en otros sectores de desarrollo de la región. Estas actividades apoyan el objetivo de LAC/RSD de promover la estabilidad y la inclusión social en América Latina y el Caribe (LAC) mediante el apoyo a una gobernanza más sólida, prácticas y valores democráticos y comunidades más seguras para los ciudadanos.

title.narrative: Can Contact Reduce Conflict between Herders and Farmers? Evidence from Nigeria

description.narrative: In Nigeria, resource conflicts between herders and farmers caused the deaths of nearly 2,000 people and displaced 300,000 more in 2017 and 2018, while costing the economy $13 billion each year. When facing violence, farmers and herders lack incentives to invest in their livelihoods and therefore become less productive. This is a vicious circle where violence over scarce resources leads to poverty, adversely affecting the 18 million people who live in the region. Worsening climate change further exacerbates these tensions. International organizations have spent over $100 million on conflict resolution activities, but with little evidence of their effectiveness. Given a rare opportunity to use a Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT) to rigorously measure the effectiveness of mediation frameworks, Development Innovation Ventures is supporting Innovations for Poverty Action (IPA) to expand and test a series of facilitated meetings (called inter-dialogues) among farmers and herders. The inter-dialogueswhich are implemented by grant partner Search for Common Ground use a common mediation framework to address pressing problems for the farmers and the herders, and aim to positively influence conflict, cooperation, and economic production. The RCT compares whether working with trained conflict resolution mediators has a bigger or smaller impact on conflicts than other types of engagements, such as health education. And effective prevention of conflicts could be significantly cheaper than remedying the aftermath. This collaboration involves some of the largest NGOs working in this area, which increases the likelihood of scaling. In addition, results will be published and disseminated to inform future conflict resolution and media interventions around the globe.

title.narrative: Alleviating Loneliness Among Migrant Garment Workers in India

description.narrative: With support from Development Innovation Ventures, Good Business Lab Foundation is building off prior pilots to conduct a randomized controlled trial (RCT) of a low-cost mental health intervention that pairs 1,000 female junior factory workers with female senior workers across six factories owned by partner Shahi Exports, India's largest exporter of ready-made garments. The RCT includes a control group and two intervention groups: one where partners meet a couple times a week to provide general social support and another where senior workers receive specialized training to help junior partners develop strategies to cope with isolation and loneliness. If effective, the intervention has the potential to improve the lives of Shahi's 150,000 workers in India and Shahi will disseminate the results to its suppliers, partners, other companies, and other organizations working with India's 120 million rural-to-urban migrant workers.
