La solution fournit une architecture modulaire ouverte qui peut évoluer à mesure que le monde et la technologie Next Gen évoluent. Enfin, la solution répond aux exigences PWS (Performance Work Statement) avec des fonctionnalités standard prêtes à l'emploi. Ceux-ci incluent : la gestion de la sécurité et des accès, les modules et services d'application, l'intégration des données des partenaires, la gestion des données : AI/ML et Insight Engine, la surveillance et la sécurité de l'infrastructure. (USAID Global Health (GH)): .A Control Tower fornece uma solução holística comercial pronta para uso (COTS) que combina técnica, análise de dados, gerenciamento de mudanças e experiência em cadeia de suprimentos. O CT é responsável pelos fluxos de dados que vão desde o armazenamento de dados do plano de fornecimento e processamento de pedidos até a análise preditiva e o desenvolvimento de painéis - tudo em apoio a uma maior visibilidade de ponta a ponta, melhor tomada de decisões e supervisão eficaz dos programas da Cadeia de Fornecimento de Próxima Geração da USAID. A solução fornece uma arquitetura modular aberta que pode evoluir à medida que o mundo e a tecnologia da próxima geração amadurecem. Por fim, a solução atende aos requisitos da Declaração de Trabalho de Desempenho (PWS) com recursos padrão prontos para uso. Isso inclui: gerenciamento de segurança e acesso, módulos e serviços de aplicativos, integração de dados de parceiros, gerenciamento de dados: AI/ML e Insight Engine, monitoramento de infraestrutura e segurança. Este prêmio é cofinanciado e cogerenciado pela OHA, PMI, FP e MCHN...

description.narrative: The purpose of this contract is to provide implementation support services and technical assistance to countries to accelerate progress in comprehensive delivery of facility and community-based malaria services, including malaria case management, prevention of malaria in pregnancy (MiP), seasonal malaria chemoprevention (SMC), health systems strengthening, data collection and use for service delivery, and other malaria prevention interventions.

L'objectif de ce contrat est de fournir des services de soutien à la mise en œuvre et une assistance technique aux pays pour accélérer les progrès dans la prestation complète de services de lutte contre le paludisme à base communautaire et en établissement, y compris la gestion des cas de paludisme, la prévention du paludisme pendant la grossesse (MiP), la chimioprévention du paludisme saisonnier (SMC), le renforcement des systèmes de santé, la collecte et l'utilisation de données pour la prestation de services et d'autres interventions de prévention du paludisme.

title.narrative: ITR/T - Digital Forward

description.narrative: (USAID Bureau for Inclusive Growth, Partnerships, and Innovation (IPI)): .The Innovation, Technology & Research Hub's Technology Division (ITR/T) established the Digital Forward Activity to build the capacity of USAID Missions, Washington Operating Units (OUs), and partners to advance digital initiatives that enhance security and economic prosperity in partner countries while safeguarding individual rights, freedom of expression, and democratic norms and practices. Digital Forward advances the research, training, strategic thinking, digital-sector partnerships, and behavior change that will equip USAID for the digital age. Digital Forward fosters the effective and responsible use of digital technology across all technical and regional sectors, and supports the growth of open, inclusive, and secure digital ecosystems in partner countries.

title.narrative: Leap Local
LEAPLocal

description.narrative: Leap Local aims to equip host country government infectious disease/tuberculosis programs with technical and management support to boost institutional capacity and deliver sustainable programming.

(USAID Global Health (GH)): O LEAP Local Africa fortalecerá os programas nacionais de doenças infecciosas e outras prioridades de saúde, capacitando os governos africanos anfitriões para liderar e gerir aspectos-chave dos seus portfólios de doenças infecciosas, bem como melhorar a coordenação entre as partes interessadas do programa de doenças infecciosas envolvidas no país e o governo anfitrião. O LEAP facilitará a ligação entre os conhecimentos técnicos locais e uma reconhecida lacuna de recursos humanos nos portfólios de doenças infecciosas em diversas entidades nacionais de saúde. Ao visar entidades locais para fornecer conhecimentos especializados como parceiro principal no âmbito dos prémios de assistência propostos, as soluções serão impulsionadas localmente, sendo as prioridades locais centrais para uma abordagem de programação inclusiva orientada para o país. Além disso, o prestador de assistência técnica será capaz de se envolver numa abordagem significativa, culturalmente apropriada, orientada para soluções locais e tecnicamente sólida, que permita orientação direta contínua e melhorias de qualidade dentro do Ministério da Saúde e outras entidades nacionais de saúde.

title.narrative: Enhancing Local Efforts for Vital, Transformative, and Evidence-Based Nutrition (ELEVATE Nutrition)
ELEVATE : Améliorer l'action locale pour l'excellence en nutrition
ELEVATE : Améliorer l'action locale pour l'excellence en nutrition
ELEVATE: Melhorando a ação local para a excelência nutricional

description.narrative: Enhancing Local Efforts for Vital, Transformative, and Evidence-Based Nutrition (ELEVATE Nutrition) to provide increased availability and use of proven nutrition interventions, including the promotion of improved nutrition practices, population-based nutrition service delivery, and improving the enabling environment and capacity for nutrition at the local level.

(USAID Global Health (GH)) : Cette activité de nutrition multisectorielle gérée par la Division de la nutrition et de la santé environnementale, avec le soutien du Bureau pour la résilience, l'environnement et la sécurité alimentaire, le Bureau de l'assistance humanitaire, devrait faire progresser la mise en œuvre locale de programmes et de politiques multisectoriels de haute qualité visant à améliorer l'état nutritionnel des femmes et des enfants, en particulier au cours des 1 000 premiers jours. Cette activité se concentre sur l'engagement des parties prenantes locales pour développer, mettre en œuvre et tirer des leçons des activités de nutrition, en reconnaissant que le développement mené localement est la principale voie pour réaliser et maintenir des progrès et que le renforcement des capacités est nécessaire pour y parvenir en matière de nutrition. Il s'attaquera aux défis nutritionnels persistants qui nécessitent une collaboration intersectorielle - améliorer la qualité de l'alimentation, renforcer les programmes de prévention et de traitement de l'émaciation, passer à des comportements et des normes plus sains en matière de nutrition et accroître l'efficacité de la gouvernance multisectorielle de la nutrition - en établissant une base de données factuelles sur la manière de mettre en œuvre des programmes et des politiques nutritionnelles efficaces (y compris la directive annuelle pour les activités nutritionnelles axées sur les micronutriments et la vitamine A, d'un montant de 459 952 $ et 137 985 $, respectivement). La gestion et le partage des connaissances entre les activités de nutrition et les pays sont un aspect important de cette activité, établissant le site NutritionLinks.org au-delà de la durée du prix.

(USAID Global Health (GH)) : Cette activité de nutrition multisectorielle gérée par la Division de la nutrition et de la santé environnementale, avec le soutien du Bureau pour la résilience, l'environnement et la sécurité alimentaire, le Bureau de l'assistance humanitaire, devrait faire progresser la mise en œuvre locale de programmes et de politiques multisectoriels de haute qualité visant à améliorer l'état nutritionnel des femmes et des enfants, en particulier au cours des 1 000 premiers jours. Cette activité se concentre sur l'engagement des parties prenantes locales pour développer, mettre en œuvre et tirer des leçons des activités de nutrition, en reconnaissant que le développement mené localement est la principale voie pour réaliser et maintenir des progrès et que le renforcement des capacités est nécessaire pour y parvenir en matière de nutrition. Il s'attaquera aux défis nutritionnels persistants qui nécessitent une collaboration intersectorielle - améliorer la qualité de l'alimentation, renforcer les programmes de prévention et de traitement de l'émaciation, passer à des comportements et des normes plus sains en matière de nutrition et accroître l'efficacité de la gouvernance multisectorielle de la nutrition - en établissant une base de données factuelles sur la manière de mettre en œuvre des programmes et des politiques nutritionnelles efficaces (y compris la directive annuelle pour les activités nutritionnelles axées sur les micronutriments et la vitamine A, d'un montant de 459 952 $ et 137 985 $, respectivement). La gestion et le partage des connaissances entre les activités de nutrition et les pays sont un aspect important de cette activité, établissant le site NutritionLinks.org au-delà de la durée du prix.

(USAID Global Health (GH)): Espera-se que esta actividade multissetorial de nutrição gerida pela Divisão de Nutrição e Saúde Ambiental, com o apoio do Gabinete de Resiliência, Ambiente e Segurança Alimentar, o Gabinete de Assistência Humanitária, promova a implementação local de programas e políticas multissetoriais de alta qualidade para melhorar o estado nutricional de mulheres e crianças, especialmente nos primeiros 1.000 dias. Esta actividade centra-se no envolvimento com as partes interessadas locais para desenvolver, implementar e aprender com as actividades de nutrição, reconhecendo que o desenvolvimento liderado localmente é o principal caminho para alcançar e sustentar o progresso e que o reforço da capacidade é necessário para alcançar este objectivo no domínio da nutrição. Enfrentará desafios nutricionais persistentes que exigem colaboração intersectorial - melhorando a qualidade da dieta, reforçando a programação para prevenir e tratar o desperdício, mudando para comportamentos e normas mais saudáveis ​​relacionados com a nutrição e aumentando a eficácia da governação nutricional multi-sectorial - através da construção de uma base de evidências sobre como implementar programas e políticas de nutrição para impacto (incluindo a directiva anual para actividades de nutrição focadas em micronutrientes e vitamina A, no valor de 459.952 dólares e 137.985 dólares, respectivamente). A gestão e partilha de conhecimentos entre atividades de nutrição e países são um aspeto importante desta atividade, estabelecendo o site NutritionLinks.org para além da vigência do prémio.

title.narrative: GenDev - buy-in ITR - Women in the Digital Economy Fund (WiDEF) (CARE)

description.narrative: (USAID Bureau for Inclusive Growth, Partnerships, and Innovation (IPI)): The Women in the Digital Economy Fund (WiDEF) is a joint effort between USAID and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation to accelerate progress on closing the gender digital divide. As part of the $50 million 3-year commitment of Gender Equity and Equality Action (GEEA) fund resources, GenDev's FY24 funds will be used to accelerate progress to close the gender digital divide by scaling evidence-based, proven solutions, including women-led solutions that improve women's livelihoods, economic security, and resilience. USAID funding will support programs that strengthen digital access and affordability; increase the design and development, especially women-led development, of relevant products and tools; increase digital literacy and skills training; address online safety and security; and increase sex-disaggregated data and research. This approach has been determined to best achieve the activity's theory of change, which is for WiDEF to: 1) help public, private sector, and civil society stakeholders to become better aware of the complex set of root causes of gender-digital inequities; 2) USAID, in collaboration with its partners, learn about the evidence-based solutions to address these inequalities; 3) for USAID and its partners to provide direct and aligned funding to to local entities to enable them to scale up these proven solutions; and 4) for the cohesive longer term impact of USAID's and its direct and aligned partners' activities to accelerate progress to close the gender digital divide, thereby improving women's livelihoods, economic security, and resilience.

title.narrative: HIV-Vista Project

description.narrative: The objective of the HIV-Vista project is to support Sub-Saharan African scientists, institutions, and innovative systems of collaboration in designing and testing improved hiv vaccine candidates that will advance the field toward the long-term goal of a safe and globally effective HIV vaccine.

title.narrative: Global Health Program Evaluation, Analysis, Research andLearning (GH PEARL)
Évaluation, analyse, recherche et apprentissage des programmes (PEARL)

description.narrative: The purpose of this activity is to strengthen effective generation and use of high-quality data and evidence to strengthen policies and program implementation in low- and middle-income countries. GH Pearl has been designed to serve as a resource for monitoring, evaluation, research and learning (MERL) related to improvements in the quality, coverage and equity of family planning (FP) and reproductive, maternal, newborn, child health and nutrition (RMNCH+N) interventions.

(USAID Global Health (GH)) : Le but de l'activité GH PEARL est de contribuer à la génération et à l'utilisation efficaces de données et de preuves pour renforcer les politiques et la mise en œuvre des programmes en matière de planification familiale ; santé reproductive; santé de la mère, du nouveau-né et de l'enfant ; et la nutrition (FP/RMNCH+N) et d’autres domaines prioritaires de la santé mondiale qui améliorent la santé et sauvent des vies dans les pays partenaires de l’USAID. L'expertise mondiale en leadership technique de GH PEARL couvre un large éventail de domaines de suivi, d'évaluation, de recherche et d'apprentissage (MERL), y compris la conception ou l'amélioration de mesures, de méthodes, d'orientations et d'outils robustes pour l'apprentissage et l'adaptation collaboratifs (CLA) de programmes, de politiques et de pratiques efficaces et de services d'application et de gestion des connaissances (KT/KM) associés. Conformément à l'accent mis par l'Agence sur la localisation, ce mécanisme a été intentionnellement conçu pour renforcer la capacité des organisations et institutions locales engagées dans le REMF à produire, analyser, visualiser, interpréter, rapporter, diffuser et utiliser des données de haute qualité pour la prise de décision afin qu'elles soient prêtes à diriger des récompenses à l'avenir.

title.narrative: Propel Youth

description.narrative: (USAID Global Health (GH)): PROPEL Youth and Gender uses policy, advocacy, governance, and financing approaches to strengthen the enabling environment and to specifically address the needs of youth and adolescents. The project addresses gender equity and equality, and the intersection of youth and gender. This fiscal year, PROPEL Youth and Gender will support country governments to leverage the Green Climate Fund financing to support gender transformative, youth responsive FP/RH programming. The project will also work with local partners in urban settings to strengthen the capacity of local organizations, including youth-led organizations and governments, to implement social accountability approaches. PROPEL Youth and Gender will also support Missions and country governments in addressing female genital mutilation/cutting and child, early and force marriage activities based on the priorities of the Mission(s) and country context.

title.narrative: CO-CREATE (Collaborative Opportunities for Climate Resilience, Empowerment, and Transformation through Education) in Sub-Saharan Africa.

description.narrative: The CO-CREATE initiative (Collaborative Opportunities for Climate Resilience, Empowerment and Transformation through Education) will test solutions to promote climate action in schools and communities with local stakeholders, in particular girls and women, to equip teachers, young people, and community members in a holistic approach with the knowledge about climate change that they will need to respond through their local contexts.

title.narrative: USAID Fragile Waters

description.narrative: USAID Fragile Waters uses locally-led approaches to increase water security in fragile contexts, working across the humanitarian-development-peace nexus, through a combination of technical assistance, grants, and analysis...USAID Fragile Waters will: ..Conduct on-demand and rapid analyses to inform water security programming; .Support capacity strengthening for local organizations to implement water security programming; .Provide direct assistance to support evolving water security needs; and .Advance learning for water security programming

title.narrative: Global Accountability Program

description.narrative: The purpose of the global accountability program (gap) is to enhance partner country systems and capacity to prevent, detect, investigate and disrupt transnational corruption, grand corruption, and kleptocracy.

title.narrative: USAID WSSH Data and Analytics Activity

description.narrative: USAIDs Water Security, Sanitation, and Hygiene Data & Analytics (WSSH D&A) Activity aims to increase the use of data and analytics in WSSH to accelerate progress toward a water-secure world. It will enable the Agency to increase data use to improve programming in the near term and strengthen the data ecosystem of the broader WSSH sectors in the longer term.
